method: Direct inspection of all eight original a2-action PNG full-page captures. No recapture, cropping, image modification, test execution or source editing.

nonBlockingFindings.description: The session-changed explanatory sentence and the reopen link have no visible separating space: correcto.Volver a abrir el asistente.
nonBlockingFindings.effect: Minor text-spacing defect; no observed loss of the link, private-content purge or recovery instruction.

scope.assistantGeneration: Declared synthetic HTTP proposals; day/context were obtained from the real action API.
scope.browser: Headless Chromium; the AG04 results file does not embed its version.

observations: The chat and action editor stay in separate columns; retained work, next action, chosen date and confirm/discard controls fit inside the editor.
The date input has a visible focus outline. Confirming an adjustment is visually distinct from continuing the canonical day.
The header background is opaque. The full-page capture places the sticky header at the capture scroll position; content behind that strip is occluded rather than bleeding through.
The editor is replaced by a compact day-1 saved receipt with the selected action and review date.
The same action appears in the canonical guidance card while the reviewed-plan card remains a separate section.
The fixed header retains readable level/streak labels where it crosses underlying content.
The revised objective and last stored adjustment are visibly distinguished from the preserved personal edit.
Check-current-context and explicit keep-my-edit acknowledgement controls are both visible; the longer acknowledgement label wraps inside its button.
Confirmation is visibly disabled before acknowledgement. Textareas and date remain within the card without horizontal clipping.
The receipt explicitly says the earlier request was recorded and its content was later deleted; it does not claim a newly saved adjustment.
The reviewed-plan card remains separate and there is no active action editor beneath the resolved deletion receipt.
At the location that failed in CI attempt 1, the header is opaque and the green CTA does not show through the level/streak labels.
The assistant conversation, adjustment editor/receipt and reviewed-plan panel are replaced by the session-changed alert and reopen link.
The shell account label shows the other synthetic owner; the old chat text is not visible.
A minor spacing defect joins the final sentence and reopen link as correcto.Volver a abrir el asistente; both remain readable and the link remains distinguishable.
The 390-pixel layout stacks chat, canonical guidance, action editor and reviewed plan in a single column.
Retained work, next action, date and confirmation/discard controls fit within the narrow card; the date focus indicator is visible.
Long text wraps and the mobile header controls remain inside the viewport. The sticky header is captured at its current scroll position.
The mobile editor is replaced by the saved day-1 receipt with its action and selected date readable.
Guidance reflects the saved step and the reviewed-plan section stays separate beneath the receipt.
Receipt lines and controls fit within the 390-pixel column without visible horizontal clipping.
The receipt says Confirmamos el ajuste que guardaste para el día 1, distinguishing recovery of a prior save from a fresh-save claim.
The recovered action and selected review date wrap within the receipt, and the canonical guidance shows that action.
The header remains opaque and the plan card remains separately readable below the recovered receipt.

automatedEvidence.contrastLimitation: Seven scans retain incomplete color-contrast results. Visual inspection does not turn these into measured passes or a full WCAG certification.
automatedEvidence.networkLimitation: The raw report retains aborted requests and deliberate connection-loss stimuli; no zero-failed-request claim is made.

limitations: This is visual review of fixed captures, not an additional interactive test or execution of any of the 54 manual UAT participant cases.
The 390×844 captures demonstrate Chromium viewport layout, not physical mobile hardware, touch, Safari or screen-reader behavior.

Sticky/fixed shell surfaces appear at the capture scroll position in these full-page screenshots. A single capture does not expose content behind that strip; interactive behavior is attributed to the separate browser harness.
The native date field shows the runner browser locale; this review does not certify locale behavior across browsers.
Synthetic generation does not establish real model utility, latency, cost, human practice outcomes or live canary activation.
No remote deployment, production schema or new business acceptance is established by this review.
